name: next_steps
title: Next Steps
description: Every concrete commitment or agreed action, with which side owns it and the spoken due timeframe.
prompt:
List every concrete next step that was actually agreed or promised on this call, one entry per action.

For each next step:
- evidence: cite the utterance(s) where the action is agreed or promised, before you write "text".
- text: the action, stated from the owner's side, <=240 characters. Quote the speaker's exact words for what was promised wherever a direct quote exists — do not convert number words to digits or digits to number words.
- owner: which side owns the action — "rep", "buyer", "joint" only when both sides explicitly share it, else "unknown". Never guess an owner the transcript does not support.
- due: the spoken timeframe copied verbatim ("by friday", "next quarter"). Use an empty string when no timeframe was spoken — never invent one.

A vague intention ("we should look into that sometime") is not a next step. Only extract actions that are actually in the transcript. An empty list is a valid, correct result when nothing was agreed.
